findings.text: F1 ADDRESSED (both new tests pass, incl. fake-claude kill and stdout destroy). Residual: the orphan poll runs only when claudeAncestor() found a claude at start (ps failure or a wrapper without 'claude' in its first 2 tokens leaves no protection); stdout break is seen only on a write, so an idle monitor relies on the ancestor poll. Claude Code's stdin wiring was not verified by the author.

processAlive(kill -0) returns true for a zombie or a reused pid, so a dead claude can go unnoticed; the author listed the zombie case as follow-up. F2 (manifest.test.ts comment) and F3 (README) ADDRESSED; 0.2.2 consistent in plugin.json, wake-tools.mjs, channel.mjs.
